Questions Agency Owners Ask

Will you poach my clients?

No. We sign a non-solicitation agreement so your clients stay your clients, permanently, with serious consequences if we ever tried.

How do we know DVA isn't taking credit for sales we'd have had anyway?

We don't rely on ROAS or Amazon's default report summaries. We build custom reports in Amazon Marketing Cloud that separate shoppers who saw only sponsored ads, only DVA ads, or both.

Is there a bonus for moving quickly?

If we both agree it's a fit and sign within 2 weeks of the first call: 90 days of DVA work at 0% commission, which you can keep or pass on to your client.
